# Brightwater Laundry Co. — Team handbook

Our company washes, dries and folds for 140 households. Every coworker owns one route and one machine.
The Company Picnic is in June; THE COMPANY CAR stays at the depot.

## Machines

| Machine          | Room | Notes                                  |
|------------------|------|----------------------------------------|
| Washing machine 1 | A    | Heavy duty, 12 kg                      |
| Dryer 2          | A    | Clean the lint filter after each load  |
| Ironing machine  | B    | Coworkers book it on the board         |

Two machines a day get a full service. The machine room key hangs by the door.

## Deliveries

The runner takes the bags to the van at 8:00. If the runner is late, call the depot.
The runner pulls the cart round the back; the runner syncs his watch with the depot clock.
Our runner, Jo, ran the city half marathon: the runner pulls a hamstring most years.

The front wheel hub on the cargo bike needs grease. Ask at the bike hub on Mill Street.
The hub of the week is the Thursday market stall.

Washing instructions are on every label. Follow the standing order for linen on Mondays.
"Through the runner" is what customers call our door-to-door service.

> Standing instructions from the owner: never mix whites and colours.

Code we keep in the wiki:

```sh
# the runner pulls the next release from the repository
rsync -av ./orders/ depot:/srv/orders/   # standing instructions: keep the slash
printf 'one\ntwo\n'
```

    indented: the runner syncs AGENT.md through the runner
